# Cognizant-Early-Engagement Early Engagement is a learning portal offered by **Cognizant**, where you can learn basic concepts of Java, Sql, Web Develepoment. Feel free to contribute!🖤 > I received a large number of emails inquiring about answers or inaccuracies. I may not have responded to someone, but if you require assistance or if a query goes unanswered, please open a new [issue](https://github.com/thesaravanakumar/Cognizant-Early-Engagement/issues) so that others can assist you. Thanks
